lines: // Seconds of fuel, kept on the plane; a new plane starts with a minute.
// With an empty tank the plane cannot move: both speeds go to 0, and back on refuelling.
const setEngine = (entity: Entity, running: boolean): void => {
// Once a second for each pilot: burn a second of fuel if the plane moved, and show the gauge.
// The script API cannot ask what a player rides, so a plane right under the player counts.
Math.abs(pos.x - Number(last[0])) + Math.abs(pos.y - Number(last[1])) + Math.abs(pos.z - Number(last[2])) > 0.5;
for (let bar = 0; bar < 10; bar += 1) gauge += bar < Math.ceil((fuel / MAX_FUEL) * 10) ? "|" : ".";
player.showActionBar(fuel > 0 ? "Fuel [" + gauge + "] " + fuel + " s" : "Out of fuel: use coal on the plane");
// Using coal or charcoal on the plane adds a minute of fuel, up to five minutes.

meta.notes: The biplane's fuel. Each plane keeps its fuel in seconds in its own saved data (entity.data), starting with a minute. Once a second for each player sitting on a plane, a second burns if the plane moved since the last check, and a text gauge shows above the hotbar; at zero the script sets the plane's speed attributes to 0, so it hangs in the air until refuelled. Using coal or charcoal on it adds a minute, up to five, and starts the engine again. The script cannot ask what a player rides, so a plane right under the player counts as theirs. Scripts run only in the Fabric mod jar export.
